body.x: Ulsan regional HQs of the Korea Institute of Industrial Technology (KITI) participated in the 2017 Korea Electronics Show (KES) held at COEX in Samsung-dong, Seoul from October 17 (Tuesday) to 20 (Friday) for 3D printing technology and consulting system.

Ulsan Regional HQs of the Korea Institute of Industrial Technology was launched as the first government-funded research institute in 2008 and has contributed to the development of local industries through the development of practical technologies such as eco-friendly materials / cutting-edge processes / roots industries / 3D printing.

It has been very active in KES 2017 to announce the institute’s supports and services for small and medium-sized companies. Mr. Kim Dong-hyun, head of the Korea Institute of Industrial Technology, was quoted as saying "We hope that many companies will be interested in variety of supports including the technical support for production lines, technology commercialization, partner company system and laboratory opening.
